card.title: Galaxy A33 5G No Display

claims.statement: Galaxy A33 with no image but working touch, unfixed by a new screen, is typically a missing VDD_LCD_ELAVDD_7P6 supply from a burned connector pin/pad.
Check diode readings at the display connector to find the pin missing its reading, then check the burned capacitor; if its reading is good, jumper it to the pin.

procedure: Diode-test the display connector for a missing reading.
Jumper capacitor to the dead pin; test; UV mask.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
